items.title: 67619_Big Nick Nicholas oral history interview
items.q: Sid Catlett would come in and visit

ctx.x: Now, Josh White, I didn't realize that Josh White had played there.

Yeah. The folk singer. And Susan Reed, they liked her. She played lute or somethin' and she sang folk songs and it was just nice. It was just nice and that's when I bought my home, you know. Then all our people would come in, like Lester would come in and visit and Sid Catlett would come in and visit and Norman Granz and Illinois Jacquet came in a couple of times and jammed. It was just wonderful. There was good money; I think I was makin' over 200 dollars a week. Yeah. And that's what give me the idea to buy a…
